name: Vitalblood Fist
description: Throw a fist loaded with blood that carries the green warmth of growing life into the target.

name: Livingtide Step
description: Step on a tide of living blood that rises through the legs and buoys the body forward.

name: Sproutbeat
description: Sprout a small new pulse in a wound of an ally or the self so fresh flesh begins to grow.

name: Lifeward
description: Ward the body with a skin of living blood that closes over each cut as it opens.

name: Greenblood Mend
description: Pour green life into the blood of a hurt ally or the self until the torn vessels grow whole.

name: Quickening Veins
description: Quicken the veins of an ally with a surge of living warmth that sharpens speed and grip.

name: Tendril Bind
description: Send blood-red tendrils from the wrist that wrap and hold a limb as living vines would.

name: Lifeflush
description: Flush poison and taint from the blood of an ally or the self with a surge of clean life.

name: Bloodbloom
description: Open a bloom of living blood-qi over the wounded that closes their hurts and lends them strength.

name: Resurgent Heartbeat
description: Seed a new heartbeat of living qi in a chest only just stopped and watch it take hold.

name: Heartbloom
description: Bloom the heart of the healer into a field of living blood that mends all the wounded and calls the just fallen back.

name: Genesis Pulse
description: streams: Blood + Life; bring both streams to one pulse that strikes with wounding vigor and mends with the same beat.

name: Ashen Fist
description: Throw a fist pale with the cold of ending that drains the color from the struck place.

name: Wane Step
description: Step as the warmth of the body wanes into stillness and slip past a watching eye.

name: Pallor Guard
description: Draw the blood from the skin so it turns pale and dull blows lose their grip.

name: Cold Pulse
description: Feel the last cold beat in a body and judge how near to ending a life has come.

name: Draining Touch
description: Lay a cold palm on the chest and draw warmth from the blood until the limbs go slack.

name: Rotting Bind
description: Wind a thread of dying blood-qi around the target that sours the flesh it touches.

name: Lingering Bleed
description: Keep a wound bleeding with a thread of ending that will not let the vessel close.

name: Deathtaint Purge
description: Purge the clinging taint of death from the blood of an ally or the self through the skin.

name: Waning Pulse
description: Touch a limb and let its pulse wane by degrees until the arm hangs without strength.

name: Last Beat
description: Stop the heart in one thrust with a point of ending thrust through the pulse beneath the breastbone.

name: Hollowing Tide
description: Draw a tide of ending outward that hollows the strength from all who stand in its path.

name: Sanguine Reaping
description: Reap the life from the blood of a marked target in one slow pull through its pulse.

name: Final Hemorrhage
description: streams: Blood + Death; run the blood to its end all at once so the body bleeds out its final strength.

name: Spiritbeat Fist
description: Throw a fist backed by a pulse of the soul so the blow lands once on the body and once beyond.

name: Soulwarm Touch
description: Warm a wound with blood and a breath of the soul so the hurt of an ally or the self eases twofold.

name: Echo Pulse
description: Hear the echo of a pulse in the soul beneath it and note when the two fall out of step.

name: Bloodsoul Bind
description: Tie the target's pulse to the soul beneath it so a pull on one drags at the other.

name: Lingering Pulse
description: Leave a soul-lit pulse in an ally that keeps their blood moving through fatigue.

name: Soulflush Mend
description: Flush qi taint and soul erosion from a patient's blood with a pulse that washes both.

name: Marrow Whisper
description: Whisper a pulse of the soul through the marrow and cloud the target's sense of its own body.

name: Spirit Hemorrhage
description: Strike a body and loose a bleed in the soul at the same instant so both lose strength.

name: Tethered Heartbeat
description: Tether the user's heartbeat to an ally's soul so both draw strength from the other.

name: Bloodsoul Rend
description: Thrust a spear of blood and soul through the body to wound the soul behind it.

name: Incarnate Pulse
description: streams: Blood + Soul; make the pulse of body and soul one beat and drive it through the target.
